question: In Table 2, which passive-targeting delivery systems have a particle size of 150 nm or more, and which of them is the largest?
expect: the PLGA/PLA/PCL polymer system (~180 nm), sEVs (~150 nm), MOF@EVs (~168 nm) and MOF (~485 nm, the largest); passive targeting covers the rows down to GO (active targeting)
rendered:
According to Table 2, the passive-targeting delivery systems with a particle size of 150 nm or more are:

* si-FOXM1-LNP (particle size: ~180 nm)
* siG12D-LODER (particle size: ~150 nm)
* siTEAD4-EXO (particle size: ~150 nm)
* siDARS-AS1-EXO (particle size: ~141 nm)
* siSLITRK4-NPs (particle size: ~141 nm)
* siSnail2-CNP (particle size: ~60 nm, but this is not 150 nm or more, so it is not included in the list)
* siTGF-β1-RPR@CCM (particle size: ~127 nm, but this is not 150 nm or more, so it is not included in the list)
* siPEG10@PMSNs-CM (particle size: ~200.7 nm)

The largest particle size among these is ~180 nm, which belongs to si-FOXM1-LNP.
